skills.name: Flowing Sails (帆流)
skills.description: Tagitsuhime attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Lurking Shark (暗鲨)
skills.description: Exclusive effect. At the end of turn, Tagitsuhime gains 1 Lurking Shark stack. When an ally's move bar is decreased, she restores the HP of the ally with the lowest HP proportion by 12% of her max HP. ;Lurking Shark (暗鲨) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Each stack increases healing effects by 10%. When she has max stacks, the onibi cost of Shark Attack is decreased by 3.

upgrades.text: When an ally's move bar is decreased, gain 1 Lurking Shark stack (can trigger once per action).
When she reaches max stacks, removes control effects from herself.
When she reaches max stacks, she gains a new turn.
At the start of battle, gain 2 Lurking Shark stacks.

skills.name: Shark Attack (猛鲨起浪)
skills.description: Tagitsihime increases the move bar of an ally by 20% and attacks all enemies twice dealing damage equal to 70% of her ATK with each attack and has a 12% base chance to inflict Freeze, lasts for 1 turn. ;Lurking Shark (暗鲨) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Each stack increases healing effects by 10%. When she has max stacks, the onibi cost of Shark Attack is decreased by 3.

upgrades.text: Boost to move bar increases to 30%.
When she has 5 Lurking Shark stacks, upon usage consumes all stacks and increases the move bar for the targeted ally by 70%.

bio.condition: With Tagitsuhime clear any zone 30 times.
